categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Xianfeng New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the building shading industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of high polymer composite shading materials (sunlight fabrics) and shading finished products such as curtains and blinds. The company also engages in the manufacturing and distribution of integrated energy-saving windows and related key materials. Its products serve both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales derived from overseas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer composite coating technologies, including high polymer composite coating formulations, single filament coating, multi-system co-extrusion coating, and heat setting technologies. It has developed proprietary technologies for producing halogen-free flame-retardant, UV-resistant, antibacterial, and environmentally friendly composite materials. Production involves extrusion coating of polyester or fiberglass yarns with polymer composites, followed by weaving and heat setting to achieve durable, energy-saving shading fabrics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include distributors and retailers in the building materials and home furnishing sectors, with a major export focus on Australia and expanding presence in Southeast Asia. The company serves commercial buildings, residential villas, public venues, and industrial textile applications. Over 70% of revenue comes from overseas markets, highlighting strong international customer reliance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Ningbo and subsidiaries in Zhejiang and other regions. It has established overseas subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand to support international sales and production. Major export markets include Australia, the United States, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Xianfeng New Material operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high polymer composite shading materials and finished shading products. It integrates upstream chemical and raw material processing technologies with downstream product assembly and distribution, providing one-stop solutions for building shading systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in flame-retardant, high-shading, environmentally friendly, and degradable polymer composite materials. R&D efforts focus on developing new shading fabrics with enhanced energy-saving, UV protection, and aesthetic properties, as well as integrated shading systems with manual and electric controls. It aims to expand product applications, improve production efficiency, and strengthen international market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of polymer composite shading fabrics and finished shading products. The company sells mainly via offline channels including distributors and retail stores, with customized orders based on client specifications. Export sales constitute a significant portion of total revenue, settled mainly in US dollars.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic high polymer composite shading material market, competing with foreign well-known manufacturers and joint ventures in the high-end segment. It benefits from first-mover advantages, proprietary technologies, and strong brand recognition. Competition is intensifying due to increasing domestic and international players, especially in mid to low-end product segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 258.9 million, a 2.64% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.7 million, showing a significant reduction in losses compared to prior years. Total assets stood at about RMB 608 million with stable operating cash flow despite challenges. The company is undergoing restructuring including divestment of subsidiaries and expansion of overseas production capacity to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Xianfeng New Material emphasizes its advanced polymer composite coating technologies that produce durable, flame-retardant, UV-resistant, and environmentally friendly shading fabrics. Its products offer dual energy-saving effects by reducing air conditioning and lighting power consumption. The company provides integrated shading solutions with customization capabilities, strong R&D innovation, and a comprehensive service model, differentiating itself through quality, technology leadership, and international market reach.
